summary:
VOYIA OS is an interactive Bio-Digital Twin and offline Edge-AI medical co-pilot designed for deep-space missions. Instead of overwhelming fatigued astronauts with complex clinical charts during 22-minute Mars communication blackouts, VOYIA OS passively triangulates wearable biometrics, cabin CO2 and radiation telemetry, and daily audio-log vocal biomarkers.   
Upon login, crew members interact with a color-coded anatomical scan displaying contextual Emergent Tips. Clicking any highlighted body zone—such as the femoral or neuro-vocal nodes—explains how microgravity and confinement affect physiological function and triggers 1-click countermeasures, including syncing resistive workouts to the ARED machine and boosting cabin CO2 scrubbers. To combat long-duration isolation, AURA-Mind runs locally on spacecraft hardware with zero latency, offering cognitive games and voice companionship. Grounded in NASA HRP and OSDR data, VOYIA OS transforms passive monitoring into autonomous deep-space survival.
details:
VOYIA OS is an interactive Bio-Digital Twin and offline Edge-AI medical co-pilot designed for deep-space missions. VOYIA OS passively triangulates three real-time data streams:

  • Passive Wearable Biometrics: Heart Rate Variability (HRV), sleep architecture, ocular strain (SANS), and estimated Bone Mineral Density (BMD) loss in microgravity.
  • Closed-Environment Telemetry (ECLSS): Real-time spacecraft cabin CO2 partial pressure (mmHg) and cosmic radiation dosimetry (mSv/day).
  • Zero-Survey AI Voice & Facial Biomarkers: Passive acoustic scanning of daily crew audio logs to detect vocal micro-tremors and cognitive fatigue without adding survey workload.

Upon logging in, crew members see a color-coded anatomical scan (Green: Nominal, Amber: Caution, Red: Action Required) alongside contextual Emergent Tips. Clicking on any highlighted body zone—such as the Bilateral Femoral System or Neuro-Vocal Node—explains how spaceflight is affecting that physiological function, displays current anomalies, and triggers 1-click autonomous countermeasures (such as syncing resistive workouts directly to the ARED exercise machine or boosting cabin CO2 scrubbers). Finally, when inactivity or isolation risks are detected, the system launches AURA-Mind, a native on-board offline AI companion that offers tactical chess, custom voice trivia, and empathetic conversation with zero latency and no Earth connection required.

What benefits and intended impact does it have?

  • Overcomes the 22-Minute Mars Communication Delay: Enables 100% autonomous health triage and decision-making without waiting up to 44 minutes round-trip for Houston medical support.
  • Reduces Cognitive Load: Translates complex multi-variable telemetry into a single intuitive visual interface and 1-click actions, critical when crew members suffer from CO2-induced headaches or fatigue.
  • Protects Mental & Behavioral Health: Actively combats long-duration isolation and boredom during crew downtime through local cognitive stimulation, reducing isolation cortisol.
  • Terrestrial Spin-Off Impact: Beyond Artemis and Mars missions, VOYIA OS can be adapted for extreme isolated environments on Earth—including Antarctic research stations, submarines, deep-sea oil rigs, and remote geriatric care.

What tools, software, and data sources were used to develop the project?

  • Prototyping & UI/UX Architecture: Figma (utilizing interactive component states, Smart Animate transitions, and dark-mode visual ergonomics to minimize crew eye strain).
  • Documentation & Presentation: GitHub (project repository and technical documentation), PowerPoint, and YouTube (video demonstration).
  • Scientific & Clinical Data Foundations: Modeled after clinical parameters from the NASA Human Research Program (HRP) Evidence Books (0G osteopenia thresholds of 1.0%–1.5% monthly BMD loss, SANS, and cognitive effects of cabin CO2 > 4.0 mmHg) and the NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR / GeneLab).

How is the project creative, and what key factors were considered?

  • Cross-Variable Root-Cause Correlation: Rather than treating symptoms in isolation, VOYIA OS connects environmental triggers with physiological data—for example, identifying that vocal tension and cognitive fatigue stem from a cabin CO2 spike rather than psychological stress alone.
  • Interactive "Click-to-Care" Ergonomics & Proactive Tips: Combining a visual anatomical map with dynamic Emergent Tips turns medical monitoring into an intuitive, educational, and proactive experience.
  • Edge-AI Privacy & Zero-Latency Reliability: Designing AURA-Mind as a native, offline on-board model guarantees continuous psychological companionship and total crew privacy even during total communication blackouts.
